headline: No school changed tier this run; tripwires unchanged, no new cancellation, no counter-trend.

tripwires.name: DHS SEVIS Help Hub CPT page
tripwires.detail: Direct fetch succeeded again 21 Sept 08:05 HKT. Page still marked 'Last Updated: August 24, 2026'; eligibility text still only requires training 'integral' to the curriculum and related to the student's major, not stated as mandatory for all students on this particular page, same BCM 2608-01/2608-02 references. Guidance page: still says SEVP plans to release draft guidance, no date. No change detected.

tripwires.name: Tufts I-Center CPT page

No change detected.

tripwires.name: Federal Register rulemaking on CPT
tripwires.detail: None found 21 Sept 08:05 HKT. Underlying CPT regulation (8 CFR 214.2(f)(10)) not amended via Federal Register; the only rulemaking remains the 17 July 2026 fixed-time-period-of-admission (duration-of-status) rule, out of scope. CPT remains guidance (12 and 24 Aug broadcast messages), not a rule.

tripwires.name: Retroactive cancellation spreading
tripwires.detail: Checked 21 Sept 08:05 HKT via newspaper, .edu and 1point3acres sweeps (zhihu not due this run). Still only Davidson (15 Aug), MIT and Skidmore interrupt already-granted CPT. No new cancellation found this run. Watching closely.

ICE is auditing schools, with SEVP decertification as the stated risk. Immigration attorneys flag a retroactive-scrutiny risk — past CPT revisited at the OPT, STEM-OPT or H-1B stage. The common institutional reading of the new standard: integral to the curriculum, required of all students in the programme for degree completion, a documented cooperative agreement with the employer, and DSO authorisation before training begins.
